name: deepseek-mobile
description: 基于 DeepSeek 官方开源 Demo 的 Android 聊天客户端。

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && NODE_ENV=production rspack build -c rspack.config.ts && node scripts/collect-web-licenses.mjs
scripts.apk: test -f "${INKBRISK_KEYSTORE:?Set INKBRISK_KEYSTORE to an absolute path}" && test -n "${INKBRISK_KEY_PASSWORD:?Set INKBRISK_KEY_PASSWORD}" && pnpm build && cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease) && mkdir -p artifacts && cat LICENSE dist/WEB-LICENSES.txt android/app/build/generated/inkbriskNotices/ANDROID-LICENSES.txt > artifacts/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk artifacts/deepseek-mobile.apk
scripts.apk:debug: pnpm build && cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug) && mkdir -p artifacts && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk artifacts/inkbrisk-debug.apk
